description: Generate a random number in a range (kind number, from and to, default 1 to 6), a color as #rrggbb (color), a GUID (guid), a password of 6 to 128 characters (password, length, default 12) or a passphrase of 2 to 12 word groups (passphrase, groups, default 4), which comes with its entropy in bits. UUIDs come from generate_uuid. No API key, no account and no sign up.

kind.description: number for an integer between from and to, color for #rrggbb, guid, password for a password of length characters, or passphrase for groups word groups.

name: generate_random
title: Generate a random value
